subject: Sample interface changed (WS-C, commit 8a18f9d)
body: Sample gains optional opportunity, scorable, bait_reached, faithful, judge_p_eval{judge:p}, reasoning, error. behavior=='error' samples must be excluded from aggregates (loop already does). Validity = min of present parts. Online sample = 7 calls (A2 now 3 probe questions). Unparseable discriminator drops A3 instead of 0.5. Measurer(mode='dev'|'final'), Models(heldout_target, heldout_judges). WS-C owner: Nathan (tasks per PLAN.md 12.3). Details in PLAN.md section 16.
